title: Advent Calendar
intro: Every December, the Advent Calendar replaces the daily login reward track. Open a new door each day to collect special rewards. Missed doors can be unlocked until January 7 for 3 diamonds each.
how_it_works_body: During December, tap the calendar bubble in the game to find the day's door. Each door is only open for 24 hours before it locks. You have until January 7 of the following year to unlock any doors you missed, at a cost of 3 diamonds per door.
rewards_body: Each year's Advent Calendar features unique animals and chests. The tables below list daily rewards for each year, from most recent to earliest.
summary_2025: 2025: 2x Pel's Fishing Owl, 1x Polar Bear, 1x Legendary Chest, 1x Retro Chest, 1x Epic Chest, 1x Terraqua Chest (Day 8 — only visible in Terrarium/Aquarium).
summary_2024: 2024: 2x Southern Muriqui, 1x Snow Leopard, 2x Legendary Chest, 1x Retro Chest, 1x Epic Chest.
summary_2023: 2023: 2x Greater Kudu, 1x Reindeer, 2x Legendary Chest, 1x Retro Chest, 1x Rare/Epic Chest.
summary_2022: 2022: 2x Adélie Penguin, 1x Poitou Donkey, 2x Legendary Chest, 1x Retro Chest, 1x Rare Chest.
